instruction: Flip the figure vertically so it mirrors from top to bottom.

metadata.explanation: This task requires vertically flipping the berry image (top-to-bottom mirror). The evaluator checks if the result image is a vertical flip of the original using SSIM comparison with 0.99 threshold. Similar difficulty to the original horizontal mirror task.
